as_told.title: John Warner IV recounts his grandfather's German flying disc

plain: A UFO activist, Steven Greer, says that a man named John Warner IV heard Paul Mellon, a very rich American, admit to going over at the end of World War Two and bringing back a flying disc built by the Nazis. The podcast host Jesse Michels tells it with more detail: over his third martini, Mellon said he and Allen Dulles, an American spy chief, were on a mission to recover technology, and that he stood on top of a saucer in Pilsen, in Czechoslovakia, not Germany. If true, it would mean flying-disc technology reached America from the Nazis in 1945.
